sources._doc: Manifest of result files read by make_figures.py. 'run' says whether a file was produced in Run 3 or inherited from Runs 1-2. Edit paths here when a worker freezes a newer file; never retype numbers.

quarantine.canonical: W-SPACE/quarantine_v3.parquet leak_free; identical to run-2 list among labelled

epi.caveat: EPI Suite was trained on PhysProp, which overlaps CompTox; EPI numbers are optimistic

noise_floor.definition: pooled within-compound SD over compounds with >=2 distinct measured values, divided by train SD, x100 (READER-1/label_noise_floor.py)

epi_joint.rules: doubtful = eChemPortal-only label, sulfonic acid/sulfate, or unpaired formal charge (READER-1); physprop = labels_v2 sources contains OPERA (READER-2)

eval_splits.model: structure-only LightGBM, W-MODEL S features, fixed hyper-parameters (W-SPACE)

ablation_run2.note: Run-2 W-MODEL v3 five-variant ablation incl. pooled run-2 spectra (supplementary)

fate_sall.run: run3 (W-MODEL v5, structure-only on all defined rows incl. ions)

figS10: Value of data (READER-2): change in RMSE per doubling of randomly added training data, by nn_sim_train bin. More of the same data helps familiar compounds far more than novel ones.
figS11: Value of data (READER-2): cost of a compound class being unseen (leave-class-out vs full training, same test compounds, with a random-removal control) and the share recovered by adding 5, 15 or 40 measurements of that class.
figS12: Headroom against label noise (READER-2): model RMSE divided by the replicate standard deviation of the labels, per endpoint.

tox_r3.leak_free: nn_sim_train < 0.40 (to the task's own training set; ChEMBL compounds are outside labels_v2 so the quarantine list does not apply)

definitions.leak_free: per-row leak_free flag from the result file, else test skeleton not in W-SPACE quarantine_skeletons.txt (nn-sim to any train skeleton >= 0.40)
definitions.bins: nn_sim_train from labels_v2 = max Morgan r2 2048-bit Tanimoto to the training split
definitions.bootstrap: cluster bootstrap over labels_v2 clusters, 1000 resamples, seed 0

spectra_only_naive: training-subset mean of the same compounds (per-row `naive` column from the result file)

henry.note: too few pairs for a delta interval

bcf.note: too few pairs for a delta interval

domain_rules.expert_note: BB_EXPERT_NOTE_Q003.md unreadable (Permission denied); derived from first principles

henry.definition: K_H relates the gas-phase partial pressure of the species to its aqueous concentration

vapor_pressure.definition: vapour pressure is the pressure of the species in the gas phase over its condensed phase

boiling_point.definition: the boiling point is where the vapour pressure of the species reaches 1 atm

koh_gas.definition: kOH here is a gas-phase reaction rate constant

logkoa.definition: K_OA is the octanol/air concentration ratio of the species

logkow.definition: K_OW is defined for the neutral (un-ionised) species

koc.definition: sorption to organic carbon is defined for dissolved ions and neutrals alike

bcf.definition: bioconcentration is defined for dissolved ions and neutrals alike

species_text.permanent_cation: a permanent cation (positive charge on an atom with no removable proton)
species_text.permanent_anion: a permanent anion (negative charge that no proton transfer removes)
species_text.permanent_zwitterion: a permanent inner salt (a permanent cation balanced by an anion; no uncharged form exists)

domain_rules.rule: UNDEFINED := endpoint requires X AND species lacks X; species after Cleanup -> largest organic fragment -> Uncharger; metal-containing parents not assessed; pKa site absence is a separate "not applicable (heuristic)" state
domain_rules.three_way: A undefined by definition / B defined but non-equivalent or not measurable by the standard protocol (heuristic) / C defined and measurable

undefined_vs_gap.expert_note: Rule derived from first principles while BB_EXPERT_NOTE_Q003.md was unreadable (Permission denied, mode 640). After the note became readable (mode 644, about 20:21) it was used ONLY to validate the derived rule (see validation_against_BB_note_Q003); none of its examples are hard-coded.

validation_against_BB_note_Q003.how: The rule was derived without the note (unreadable until about 20:21); its examples are used here ONLY as a check.
validation_against_BB_note_Q003.note_disagreement: BB groups sulfonate/sulfate salts with permanent cations (undefined). Our derivation puts strong-acid parents in B ("defined only for an unpopulated neutral microspecies"): the free acid exists as a neutral species in principle, but not at any environmental pH. Dashboard behaviour is the same (refuse to give a number); the bookkeeping differs.
